proof-no-false-premise.notes: No False/contradictory hypothesis; B1Figure8RowContext is inhabitable (depth=2, a nonzero real), so the conditional is not vacuously true via False.elim.

proof-no-unused-hypotheses.notes: In the library file both class fields are used (one per conjunct); no unused hypothesis. (The deeper problem is they are the conclusion, captured under self-assuming-projection.)

proof-no-decide-masking.notes: `trivial` closes the resolved sibling's `: True` goal — it masks the absence of any substantive proof of the narrative claim. Flagged minor since the underlying defect is the vacuous goal (covered by proof-no-trivial-true), not decide on a real goal.

da-false-claim.notes: The mathematical content is true: Murakami-Murakami 2001 proved the volume conjecture for 4_1; Vol(4_1)=2 Cl_2(pi/3)=2.0299..; Bloch-Suslin gives K_3^ind; dim K_3^ind(Q(zeta_6))=1. All standard and correctly stated.

da-vacuous.notes: As a formal object the proposition is vacuous: the resolved Lean is `: True := trivial` and the library variant is a self-assuming projection of its own conclusion. The narrative is genuine, but the 'theorem-level' formal backing is content-free.

da-circular.notes: The mathematical argument is not circular (it cites independent published results); the circularity is only in the Lean self-projection, recorded under proof-no-self-assuming-projection.

da-referee-verdict.notes: VERDICT: mathematically sound proposition with a hollow formal backing. The narrative discharge (Bloch-Suslin + Borel + Murakami-Murakami) is correct and well-cited, but the Lean sibling resolves to `b1_figure_8_row : True := trivial` and the library variant is a self-assuming projection of its own conclusion (depth_eq_2, bloch_wigner_ne_zero) — so a 'theorem-level' proposition carries zero verified content. Strongest objection: proof-statement-integrity / self-assuming-projection. Fix: formalise (or honestly demote the formal claim and keep the result as a cited narrative theorem).
